notes.title: Anaria: Reborn – A New Beginning
notes.notes:
[p]📢 [b]Important Announcement: Anaria is Being Reborn[/b][/p][p]First of all, I want to sincerely thank everyone who played Anaria and supported it, despite the rough edges. I know the game suffered from poor optimization and bugs, and I truly apologize for that experience.[/p][p]Anaria was my very first project — something I began years ago when I had little to no experience. Eventually, I released it on Steam to see if it was worth pursuing game development seriously. The response, even with its flaws, meant the world to me.[/p][p]Now, I’m excited to announce that I’ve rebuilt the game from scratch.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Introducing: [i]Anaria: Reborn[/i][/b]
A completely reimagined and polished version of the first chapter:[/p][list][*][p]Vastly improved performance[/p][/*][*][p]Major visual upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother gameplay and cleaner mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Bug reduction to a minimum (because let’s be honest—no game is ever truly bug-free)[/p][/*][/list][p]The game will be released as a [b]brand-new title[/b], under the name [i]Anaria: Reborn. [/i]Everyone who owns the original version will receive a [b]significant discount[/b] on the new game.[/p][p]This isn’t just a patch — it’s a whole new experience. The vibe, the atmosphere, and the storytelling have been refined dramatically. I can't wait for you to see how far it has come.[/p][p]Thank you for sticking with me on this journey.
The world of Anaria is only just beginning.[/p]

notes.title: Resolution and Enemy
notes.notes:
Added support for resolutions up to 4K (3840x2160)

Adjusted enemy AI: enemy is now slightly easier to avoid/detect

notes.title: A New Beginning: Anaria Is Getting a Full Remake
notes.notes:
[h3]📢 Upcoming Update & Roadmap for [i]Anaria[/i][/h3][p]Hey everyone, thank you so much for playing [i]Anaria[/i] and for all the feedback so far!
Your support means the world to me — as a solo indie dev, every comment helps shape the future of the game.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Next Update – Full Remake Incoming![/b]
I'm currently working on a [b]complete remake of Anaria[/b], rebuilding it from the ground up with:[/p][list][*][p]Major performance optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals and mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]All known bugs fixed[/p][/*][/list][p]This will be the [b]definitive version[/b] of the current chapter.[/p][p]🎮 [b]After That – Bonus DLC Minigame[/b]
As a creative bonus, a small standalone [b]DLC Minigame[/b] will follow — something fresh, eerie and experimental for the fans of twisted ideas.[/p][p]📖 [b]And Later – Chapter II[/b]
Once the remake and DLC are done, I’ll begin working on [b]Chapter 2[/b], continuing Anaria’s dark story in new terrifying directions.[/p]
